subject.title: BUG: Workboard cannot spawn ACP workers (opencode / Codex / Claude Code)

question: Should Workboard officially support ACP-backed card workers, and should that capability be exposed through a generic plugin/SDK execution seam rather than a Workboard-specific call into core ACP spawning?
rationale: Current main supports only embedded subagent execution for Workboard cards, while the requested change introduces a new execution mode with lifecycle and security-boundary consequences that source inspection cannot choose unilaterally.

options.title: Sponsor an SDK-backed ACP worker design
options.body: Define a generic plugin-safe ACP worker launch and monitoring contract, then implement Workboard as its first consumer.

options.title: Keep Workboard embedded-only
options.body: Retain the current embedded-subagent model and direct users to existing ACP session workflows outside Workboard.

options.title: Defer pending harness design
options.body: Keep the issue open as an agent-harness design request until a maintainer defines the supported execution-state model.

recommendation.title: Sponsor an SDK-backed ACP worker design
recommendation.body: Define a generic plugin-safe ACP worker launch and monitoring contract, then implement Workboard as its first consumer.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Workboard lifecycle work makes this the strongest available adjacent routing signal, though the ACP platform owner may need to co-decide.
